extracted.name: Scotch & soda
extracted.description: Put your feet up and enjoy a simple cocktail of scotch whisky and soda. You can make it as strong as you like. Garnish with a lemon slice to serve
instruction_lines: Add a few ice cubes to a tumbler or highball glass, depending on preference. Add the whisky and stir to chill the glass. Top up with soda water, depending on how strong you like it. Stir briefly, add a lemon slice if you like.
